scope: Focused same-origin browser client checks using only an injected authored fake fetch transport.
caseNames: construction performs no request and BFF calls retain same-origin credentials and session CSRF
login logout and password responses rotate only the in-memory CSRF used by later requests
a session read started before login cannot replace the newer authentication CSRF
expired-session and request-integrity errors require a fresh session before another mutation
failed mutations are never retried automatically and an explicit retry preserves caller request identity
a finite timeout aborts the fake transport and preserves uncertainty for an already dispatched write
caller cancellation before dispatch is distinct from an interrupted in-flight write
foreign-shaped targets unsupported actions and invalid local payloads never reach a transport
malformed UTF-8 JSON and non-record replies fail visibly and a malformed write acknowledgment stays uncertain
declared and streamed oversized replies are bounded without accepting partial JSON
redirect refusal missing responders and fixed server errors do not expose transport or provider details
malformed authentication envelopes clear cached CSRF until another valid session is read
limits: No browser, server, database, provider, real identity or network request was used.
This verifies client behavior with authored responses; it does not prove live Auth, email delivery, PostgreSQL integration, hosted configuration, responsive rendering or runtime execution.
An earlier invocation's output was not retained after tool-output truncation; only this captured run supports the stated outcome.
